code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    bounds, counts = {}, {}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        bounds[color] = (min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells))
        counts[color] = len(cells)
    outer = inner = None
    for a in colors:
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = bounds[a]
        for b in colors - {a}:
            q0, q1, d0, d1 = bounds[b]
            if r0 <= q0 <= q1 <= r1 and c0 <= d0 <= d1 <= c1 and counts[a] + counts[b] == (r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1):
                outer, inner = a, b
                break
        if outer is not None:
            break
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = bounds[outer]
    q0, q1, d0, d1 = bounds[inner]
    ih, iw = q1-q0+1, d1-d0+1
    rim = min(q0-r0, r1-q1, d0-c0, c1-d1)
    pad = ih if ih == iw else rim
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0-pad), min(h, r1+pad+1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0-pad), min(w, c1+pad+1)):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = inner
    return out
'''
